K_posthoc_check.note: the K=1 promise is checked after the fact in dial_table.csv (abs_v_median and residual_level columns); it is a convention, not a guarantee (spec §2)

generator_offset_note: explicit 0: this run deliberately shares the parent run's seed set and random stream (S-pair).

window_definition.note: the host's _window_indices keeps only step %% task_period == 0, so a 10-task window has 10 records, not the 100 the spec's S-mask text asserts. The spec's own requirement that U^(10)_100 and U^(10)_500 equal the 1M/5M U_k, and the fact that the committed controls' U_k were built that way, both force the task-ends-only reading. A spec addendum is needed.

S_dial.note: closed-form + K=1 substitution; not an experimental output

S_fd.note: the registered Phi = 0.5*(1+erf) cancels in the deep negative tail, so the central difference stops being informative there; those probes are checked against the erfc form instead. The registered arithmetic is unchanged (spec §4.3).

S_num.note: saturation depths are recorded, not judged

S_ref.note: logs/*.npz and ckpts/*.pt are gitignored; the control side of V3 and §5.5 is not reproducible from a fresh clone. m_minus for the controls comes from the 5M checkpoint (single record point, window label final_step5000000), not from the 491-500 window.

S_mob.note: mob is a linear function of p_hat on ReLU/leaky; it is an independent quantity only on ELU/SiLU/GELU arms

S_pair.caveat: init/teacher/input realization only; trajectories diverge after step 1

S_mask.resolution: the host's _window_indices keeps only step %% task_period == 0, so a 10-task window has 10 records, not the 100 the spec's S-mask text asserts. The spec's own requirement that U^(10)_100 and U^(10)_500 equal the 1M/5M U_k, and the fact that the committed controls' U_k were built that way, both force the task-ends-only reading. A spec addendum is needed.
S_mask.control_diff_note: controls are compared against the transcribed verdict.csv values, so a nonzero diff there would mean the committed endpoint and the committed logs disagree
